name: Aozora Enikki
source:
I thought those days would go on forever...
That summer day, we...

This multi-scenario adventure tells the story of Kirimiya Shou and the troubles he faces as he finds his heart drawn to two sisters during his last summer vacation as a student.

It's a true-to-life story of a young man feeling guilt towards a forbidden love, and yet unable to suppress his desires.

[Translated from [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]Getchu.com[/url]]
translation:
我原以为那些日子会一直持续下去……
那个夏日，我们……

这部多路线冒险游戏讲述桐宫奖在学生时代最后一个暑假，被两姐妹吸引并为此烦恼的故事。

这是一个年轻人对禁忌之恋心怀愧疚，却仍无法抑制欲望的写实故事。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]Getchu.com[/url]]
